info.name: Amazon CodeGuru Security AccountConfiguration Findings API

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of results to return in the response. Use this parameter when paginating results. If additional results exist beyond the number you specify, the nextToken element is returned in the response. Use nextToken in a subsequent request to retrieve additional results.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: A token to use for paginating results that are returned in the response. Set the value of this parameter to null for the first request. For subsequent calls, use the nextToken value returned from the previous request to continue listing results after the first page.

params.name: scanName
params.description: The name of the scan you want to retrieve findings from.

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the findings you want to get. Pass either Open, Closed, or All.

items.docs: Returns a list of all findings generated by a particular scan.
